dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features approximately 5 prominent elliptical 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The perimeters are defined by high-intensity light pixels forming a sharp gradient transition against the darker surrounding and interior pixel fields; edges are irregular and non-uniform in thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate spatial density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters, appearing primarily as isolated, asymmetrical specks without internal gradients, concentrated mostly along the upper dorsal ridge and posterior transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct central macro-annuli form a scalene triangle, while the relationship between the two most posterior annuli and the nearest high-intensity blob forms a nearly linear horizontal arrangement.
